Contributing to OccurrenceCleaner

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thanks for taking the time. This page covers how to set up, test and submit changes.

Code of Conduct

By participating you agree to the Code of Conduct.

Installation for development

git clone https://github.com/gcol33/OccurrenceCleaner.git
cd OccurrenceCleaner
install.packages(c("devtools", "roxygen2", "testthat", "Rcpp", "vectra", "knitr", "rmarkdown"))
# for the equivalence tests and the benchmark
install.packages(c("CoordinateCleaner", "geosphere", "rnaturalearth"))
devtools::load_all()

A C++ compiler is needed (Rtools on Windows). After editing anything under src/, run Rcpp::compileAttributes() and devtools::document(). After a header-only change, delete src/*.o and src/*.dll (or .so) first, or nothing is recompiled.

Testing

devtools::test()
devtools::check(args = "--no-manual")

Tests that need CoordinateCleaner, geosphere, rnaturalearth or network access skip when those are not available. The GBIF snapshot test looks for a Parquet directory in OCC_GBIF_SNAPSHOT and skips otherwise.

Principles to keep

  • Flag, never drop. A test writes one bit; it never removes a record or bakes in a threshold.
  • Equivalence is the trust argument. A CoordinateCleaner-equivalent test must agree with that package record by record, or the disagreement is documented in tests/testthat/test-equivalence.R, in ?flag_occurrences and in dev_notes/equivalence.md.
  • One front door. New behaviour is an argument of flag_occurrences() or tally_flags(), not a new verb. Never export CoordinateCleaner’s cc_* names.
  • Pinned reference data. A new gazetteer comes with a data-raw/ script that records source URL, version, retrieval date and SHA-256, and a row in reference_info().
  • A new test adds a row to the layout in R/flag_tests.R (bumping layout_version if any existing bit changes), a branch in flag_chunk(), unit tests, and a line in the README table.

Project organization

R/            flag.R (front door and engine), stream.R (on-disk input), tally.R,
              flag_tests.R (layout), columns.R, reference.R, shapefile.R
src/          geodesic (Vincenty), kdtree (unit sphere), polygon_index (grid PIP), rcpp_api
data-raw/     builds R/sysdata.rda from Natural Earth and GRSciColl
tests/        unit, equivalence, streaming
bench/        benchmark against CoordinateCleaner
dev_notes/    equivalence findings, reference-data comparison, benchmark table

Workflow

  1. Open an issue for anything beyond a small fix.
  2. Branch from main, commit with a clear message.
  3. devtools::test() and devtools::check() pass.
  4. Open a pull request describing what changed and why.

Style

R: tidyverse style, roxygen2 with markdown, ASCII only in roxygen. C++: C++11, no external libraries, implementations in .cpp files with declaration-only headers. Tests: one test_that() per behaviour, expect_identical() where the value is exact.

Reporting bugs

Open an issue with a minimal reproducible example, the output of sessionInfo(), and, for a flag you believe is wrong, the record’s coordinates and the CoordinateCleaner result for the same record if you have it.
